attackers_goals: Trick users into executing malicious files by making their file types seem benign.
description: An attacker may use a special right-to-left (RTL) override character to trick users into executing malicious files that look like benign file types.
investigative_actions: Investigate the executed process. There is no reason for benign files to contain the Unicode right-to-left override character in their name.
name: Unicode RTL Override Character
